definitions.errors: Signed error is measured volume minus the prospective forecast, in nominal mL. Each planned head, scenario and block contributes at most one pour. Scores use the first optically complete attempt, including a wrong burst count. Wrong waveforms cannot pass and their numeric errors appear separately.
definitions.ruler: Both readings come from the same experimental pour. The independently read optical measure tests sensitivity to how the camera observes the graduated cup. It does not supply a second experimental replicate.
definitions.coverage: Counts use all planned blocks as the denominator. A posted primary forecast is required. Primary pass also requires the preregistered mean signed-error bound. Corroborated pass additionally requires the preregistered independent optical coverage.
definitions.clock: The stock controller reports the first cycle timing and the number of bursts at pour closure. The optional final elapsed time is compared with ideal policy closure, which includes the cooldown. Individual gate edges are not instrumented.
definitions.clear_pixels: A separate pre-validation model predicts the settled motion of a clear foreground patch in native pixels. The journal's working-coordinate change is divided by its acquisition scale to recover the sensor displacement. Relative errors use this model's own frozen pixel prediction. The two printed scales use the frozen primary volume prediction.
definitions.repeat_diagnostics: First and last groups use consecutive registered blocks. Within-scenario correlations center each measure on its own head/scenario mean before pooling the replicates. All measures come from the same camera and couple optical readout, cup registration, liquid shape, and pump delivery.
definitions.sightline_gap: Half the separation between the two volume readings is a lower bound on the absolute measurement error of at least one reading of this pour. A full gap larger than twice the registered tolerance makes the two acceptance intervals disjoint.
